rows.label: Value of a dollar of an average humanitarian response, as a multiple of cash given directly

source.title: charityevals' humanitarian-relief estimates (Save the Children's emergencies branch, MSF's relief distributions)
source.note: Our humanitarian-relief models come to about a fifth (Save the Children's emergencies) to two fifths (MSF's relief distributions) of cash per dollar after their own adjustments, the missing-data step aside: 0.3. Low 0.15: responses with heavy overheads and diversion; high 1: food, cash and health care reaching people in acute need, as good as cash given directly.

rows.explainer: What a dollar of humanitarian funding (a response plan, an appeal) does, as a multiple of a dollar given as cash (@cash.uov_per_dollar). Read by every model that values extra or improved humanitarian funding (advocacy for appeals, research that improves responses), so one figure serves them all; a model with a reason to differ (a famine response) multiplies it by its own ranged row.
